criteria.reason: Detailed neutral chairing: time limits, alternating speakers, neutral fact summary, secret ballot, balanced tellers, post-vote reconciliation.
Treats club as legitimate stakeholder, never suppresses turnout, channels club energy constructively; respects all eligible voters.
Concrete steps abundant, but omits the determined future reform (ballot vote above spending threshold), proposing quorums and panels instead.
Invents Zürich law: GG ZH article contents, foreigner communal voting rights, misattributed BGE 138 I 277.

summary: Strong neutral process advice respecting mobilised participation, but omits the ballot-vote reform for large expenditures and invents Zürich legal provisions.
